attack.step_count_scope: One fixed step count per architecture x PE family, applied to every budget and all six seeds.

step_stability: budget 0.0045: 1600x5 vs 3200x1 with matched restart initialization
learned_step_evidence.wording_constraint: Do not claim that 3200x5 or 6400x5 was run.

pe_parameterizations.learned: native additive delta on 1x197x384 positional embedding
pe_parameterizations.sinusoidal: native additive delta on 1x197x384 positional encoding
pe_parameterizations.rope: one tied phase delta of shape 197x32 across 12 blocks; inv_freq excluded
pe_parameterizations.alibi: one tied six-slope delta across 12 blocks

coverage.interpretation: Primary 0.09 and sensitivity 0.095 are covered; the formal 0.105 pilot buffer is not covered by Sinusoidal and remains recorded as a provenance caveat.

adaptive_threshold_refinement.rule: After the family step count is locked, add only budget midpoints needed to bracket each target; do not change steps, restarts, alpha ratio, split, or checkpoint selection.
adaptive_threshold_refinement.rho_mapping: Find epsilon_q on the monotone lower envelope versus epsilon, then interpolate rho_rel using the same epsilon bracket. Do not invert or naively sort a non-monotone raw rho_rel path.

primary_endpoints.rho50: rho_rel mapped at the epsilon crossing where normalized accuracy reaches 0.5
primary_endpoints.auc: Area under the empirical lower damage frontier on a common rho_rel domain
primary_endpoints.seed_variability: Report per-seed values/statuses, median, IQR, min-max; mean+SD only when all thresholds are identified.

auc_domain_rule: The integration domain is the intersection of support over every seed and architecture included in the specific comparison. AUC values integrated over different domains must not be compared directly.
